sn38.12:1.6: SN 56:11 says that the five clinging-aggregates should be comprehended. However, SN 22:121 defines clinging as desire and passion; SN 22:139; SN 22:142; SN 22:145 note that any desire and passion for the aggregates should be abandoned. What this means is that the complex of clinging-aggregates should be comprehended as suffering. The clinging in that complex should be abandoned.
